products.name: PT Referral Paperwork Queue
products.product: A focused physical therapy referral and authorization paperwork workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent physical therapy clinics and small rehabilitation practices
products.problem: Referral orders, payer steps, demographics, prior records, scheduling, and patient outreach mature separately before the first visit.
products.valueProposition: Turns physical therapy referral and authorization paperwork into a visible operating queue so every scheduled evaluation has its clinic-defined administrative prerequisites complete or an owned exception.
products.topic: physical therapy referral and authorization paperwork
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
